items.title: Reproduce and close the remaining candidate-routing freshness leak
items.context: Read the preserved failing reference only through immutable git object 2c9395fa22e18ca40ba3ee47d9d40c2ad748e009; never apply or pop a stash. Reconstruct a minimal story-branch regression, confirm it initially fails, then determine whether candidate selection or only order moves under changedPaths churn. If order is the cause, bind a sorted path+contentHash set. The completed test must positively assert that a semantically unchanged re-route leaves the epoch State: OPEN, not merely absence of one blocker.

happy.desc: Build the handler smoke, freeze an OPEN review-inventory epoch, then reroute a valid candidate artifact whose candidate rows contain the identical path/contentHash pairs in a different order. The real review_inventory_status handler must report State: OPEN. WHY: the barrier compares the canonical routing universe, not producer ordering.

edge.desc: From the same frozen OPEN epoch, reroute a valid artifact with either one selected path changed or one selected contentHash changed. The real status handler must persist State: INVALIDATED with OPEN_REVIEW_INVENTORY_CANDIDATE_ROUTING_MUTATION. WHY: canonicalization must not launder a genuine candidate-universe change.

adversarial.desc: Assert the order-neutral case uses exactly the same path/contentHash multiset and separately assert every changed path/contentHash fixture invalidates; do not accept a test that only compares digest helper output without exercising persistInvalidationIfDrifted. WHY: this prevents a weak sort that either still leaks ordering or hides selection drift.

verification.selector: B-8af0 canonical barrier real-handler discriminates order: PASS

items.userSees: After rerouting reordered but semantically identical candidates, the terminal shows `State: OPEN`; after a selected path or contentHash changes, it shows `State: INVALIDATED` and `OPEN_REVIEW_INVENTORY_CANDIDATE_ROUTING_MUTATION`.

verificationEvidence.note: The real handler fixture proves a reordered but identical selected path/content multiset remains OPEN at final HEAD.

items.title: Guard malformed candidate input at the gate boundary
items.context: Persist a malformed candidate-spec artifact whose candidates field is truthy but not an array, then exercise the real review-inventory handler path through persistInvalidationIfDrifted. It must fail closed with a deterministic candidate-artifact blocker and must never throw an uncaught TypeError; verifier-only coverage is insufficient because this path is called by multiple lifecycle gates without a catch boundary.

happy.desc: Persist a signed-looking candidate-spec artifact with a truthy non-array candidates field, invoke review_inventory_status through the real handler so it reaches persistInvalidationIfDrifted, and assert State: INVALIDATED plus the stable OPEN_REVIEW_INVENTORY_INVALID_CANDIDATE_ARTIFACT blocker. WHY: the gate must classify malformed persisted input instead of treating it as absent or throwing.

verification.selector: B-8af0 malformed candidates fail closed: PASS

edge.desc: Exercise at least string and object truthy non-array candidates through the same real handler path and assert neither invocation escapes as TypeError; each result must be the same deterministic invalid-candidate-artifact blocker. WHY: falsy-or-null validation alone does not cover the crash class.

verification.selector: B-8af0 malformed candidate variants deterministic: PASS

adversarial.desc: Use a malformed artifact whose other digest/signature-shaped fields are internally consistent, then prove the structural candidates check still wins before the barrier projects candidate rows. WHY: an attacker must not recompute a digest around a non-array shape to bypass fail-closed handling.

verification.selector: B-8af0 malformed candidate structural guard: PASS

adversarial.desc: Mutate a valid candidate artifact without recomputing artifactDigest and prove verifyCandidateSpecSet rejects it. WHY: canonical barrier comparison must not weaken the independent full-artifact tamper detector.

items.userSees: When review-inventory reads a persisted artifact with a truthy non-array `candidates` field, the terminal shows `State: INVALIDATED` and `OPEN_REVIEW_INVENTORY_INVALID_CANDIDATE_ARTIFACT`, never an uncaught `TypeError`.

verificationEvidence.note: The candidate-routing smoke proves the independent full artifactDigest tamper verifier still rejects a modified artifact.

items.title: Add the end-to-end routing-neutral regression fixture
items.context: Build the regression in the handler smoke from immutable fixture facts, not by applying a stash.
